subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He managed to save his father’s business by t__he sweat of his brow.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"by the sweat of his brow"** means achieving something through hard work and effort. (कड़ी मेहनत से)

 
 
• **Example: **He built his company from scratch **by the sweat of his brow.**
 
 
 
• **Hard work** refers to putting in a lot of effort and dedication to achieve a goal. (कड़ी मेहनत)
 
 
• **Example: **She succeeded in her exams through **hard work **and determination.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is **hard work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incidentally** (संयोगवश): Occurring by chance or without intention.

 
 
• **Example: Incidentally**, I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
 
 
 
• **Tricks and strategies** (चालें और रणनीतियाँ): Using clever methods or plans to achieve something.
 
 
• **Example: **He used various** tricks and strategies** to win the game.
 
 
 
• **Any way possible** (किसी भी तरह से): Achieving something by any means, regardless of the method.
 
 
• **Example:** He was determined to succeed **any way possible.**
 
 

1a5:Tc64,

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
